_rules: One entry per INN-### ID. Agents may add entries (decision: PENDING) and may fill promoted_to after a promote run.
Agents never overwrite an entry whose decision is not PENDING.
Humans set decision to ACCEPT | REJECT | DEFER here or in the decision block of requirements/innovation-opportunities.md. On conflict this file wins and the agent reports the conflict.
Only ACCEPT items are promoted, and only by the promote run mode.
